overview.title: Find the public tenders you can win — and see what you still need to prove
overview.lead: Kvia screens every new Doffin notice against your search profile, reads the tender documents once for all firms, and compares the requirements with your Capability Locker. Every result shows its sources, so you can check it yourself.

screening.title: Ranked screening
screening.text: One list of all active notices, ranked by fit, with a confidence indicator.

report.title: Diagnostic report
report.text: Requirement checklist with page references, missing documents and a go / borderline / no-go indication.

review.title: Human review
review.text: Advisers check uncertain extractions; you can flag any result; you decide whether to bid.

overview.forWhomText: firms with 5–50 employees and little or no bidding history, used by a named bid coordinator.
overview.topNote: Top 5 of your ranked screening list.
overview.keyFigures: Key figures of the current run

kpi.missingSub: proof needed, expired or not on file

overview.howSub: Three steps that differ in what they process and how their cost scales. Orange = AI step, blue = human decision.

adviser.title: Adviser releases
adviser.text: flagged notices only after checking or correcting the extraction.

flag.title: You can flag
flag.text: any AI result with a short description (clarification desk).

decide.title: You decide
decide.text: whether to bid. Nothing is submitted automatically.

overview.disclaimerMore: Go, borderline and no-go are derived by fixed rules from the requirement checklist — never by the AI model.

pre.title: Pre-processing
pre.text: Once per notice, on arrival: retrieval finds the relevant passages in the tender documents; extraction lists every mandatory requirement and proof demand with its source page. Reused for every firm.

screen.title: Screening
screen.text: Per firm: every data point of a released notice, incl. title and description, is matched with your search profile. Code combines the sub-scores into a fit score from 0 to 100.

report.title: Diagnostic report
report.text: Per firm: each stored requirement is linked to your Capability Locker and rated met / partly met / not met / lacks data. Code checks proof validity on the deadline and derives the indication.

notices.title: Notices
notices.sub: All {real} notices of the Doffin snapshot, unaltered, plus {mock} clearly labelled MOCK notices that exist only to demonstrate modes the real data cannot show.
notices.rule: Rule-based filters only — screening never pre-filters on CPV or keywords.

f.text: Free text (title, English title, description, buyer)
f.vunknownExclude: Exclude when a range is set

notice.flaggedText: This notice is flagged for adviser review. It has no fit score and no report for any firm until an adviser releases it.
notice.placeholderDocs: PLACEHOLDER (MOCK) — generated document, not the tender document. Replaced by the originals in Phase 2.
notice.originalDocs: Original documents from the buyer’s platform
notice.extractedNote: {n} requirements stored by pre-processing (shared by all firms). Click to show the cited passage.
notice.noExtraction: No released requirements for this notice.
notice.allFieldsSub: All {n} fields exactly as in the Doffin export — nothing removed or edited. Derived values are shown separately.
notice.contactNote: kept unaltered; not sent to any AI prompt
notice.value_missing: missing → excluded from the fit score, lowers confidence
notice.value_zero_treated_as_unknown: 0 is treated as unknown, never as NOK 0
notice.anyw: anyw = performance anywhere in Norway → compatible with every region
notice.statusIgnored: status is empty; activeness uses notice type + deadline instead

screening.title: Screening
screening.sub: One ranked list of all {n} screened notices, sorted by fit score. Notices at or above {th} are forwarded to a diagnostic report; nothing below the line is hidden.
screening.nearMisses: below: near misses first — add any notice manually
screening.pendingNote: {n} notices are flagged for adviser review and are not screened until released.
screening.howFit: How the fit score is computed
screening.howFitText: By code, not by the model: weighted mean of the available sub-scores; missing ones are left out and lower confidence.
screening.noConfReasons: No missing data point and no contradiction.
screening.footnote: Mock run: sub-scores are generated by code from CPV/NUTS/value overlap (team decision for Phase 1); aggregation, confidence and routing are the real code.

reports.sub: Reports for notices forwarded by screening or added by you. Flagged notices wait for adviser review first.
reports.manualSub: Below-threshold notices the bid coordinator added; logged as missed matches for the feedback loop.
reports.awaitingSub: No fit score and no report for any firm until an adviser releases the notice.
reports.noneManual: None yet. Use “Create diagnostic report” in the ranked list or on a notice.
reports.noneAwaiting: No notice is waiting for review.

report.hiddenText: This notice scored {fit} for your firm, below the threshold of {th}, so it was not forwarded automatically. You can add it manually.
report.stateManualRecorded: Manually added (recorded in the mock run)
report.computedByCode: Computed by fixed rules from the checklist
report.checklistSub: {n} requirements, each with source page. Click a row to see the passage in the document.
report.readinessRule: Documentation readiness on the tender deadline
report.expiringText: Valid on the deadline, but expires within 30 days after it — renew before contract start.
report.flagDisabled: Example only — the clarification desk is not live in the prototype.
report.missingDocsSub: Demanded proof that is self-declared, expired or not on file

readinessText.not_demanded: The tender demands no documented proof for this requirement.

indicationReason.proof_not_documented_valid: Demanded proof not documented and valid on the deadline
indicationReason.met_below_high_confidence: Met, but not with high confidence (treated as borderline)
indicationReason.all_met_high_and_documented: All requirements met with high confidence; all demanded proof documented and valid on the deadline

logic.sub: The mechanism chain step by step: which steps are AI and which are fixed code, and the deterministic rules with their assumptions.
logic.chainSub: Matches Figure 2 in the AI mechanism chain document.
logic.phase1Note: Specified model for all AI steps: {model}. In this Phase 1 mock run the AI outputs are generated by code from templates; in Phase 2 they are produced in a development chat on the team’s command. The website never calls a model.

activeness.title: Activeness rule
activeness.text: The status field is ignored (it is empty for some competition notices). Award notices carry future dates, so the deadline alone is not enough. A competition notice without a deadline is flagged, not dropped.

gate.title: Release gate (flag triggers)
gate.text: Any one trigger flags the notice. A flagged notice stays visible but gets no fit score and no report until an adviser releases it.
gate.uncited: Low extraction confidence: a requirement without a valid citation
gate.conflict: Low extraction confidence: conflicting values across documents
gate.schema: Low extraction confidence: schema validation fails
gate.rating: Low extraction confidence: model self-rating low
gate.not: Not triggers: missing CPV, contract type, estimated value or other structured fields — they are excluded from the fit score and lower its confidence.

weights.title: Fit score weights
weights.text: over the sub-scores that are not missing, weighted toward subject relevance.

threshold.title: Threshold and routing
threshold.text: Forwarded if fit ≥ {th}; otherwise below threshold. All screened notices stay in one ranked list; the near misses are simply the top of the below-threshold part.
threshold.lots: Multi-lot: a notice is forwarded if any lot reaches the threshold; other lots are shown as not relevant.

confidence.title: Confidence bands
confidence.text: Starts at high and drops one level per missing data point with weight ≥ 0.10 and per contradiction the model reports (e.g. place of performance vs. buyer location, aggregate vs. call-off value): high → medium → low.

readiness.title: Documentation readiness
readiness.documented: Documented: proof status Documented and valid on the tender deadline.
readiness.self: Self-declared — proof needed: Self-declared or only partly documented (e.g. 2 of 3).
readiness.expired: Expired: expiry date before the tender deadline.
readiness.none: No proof on file: value declared missing or no locker field (agent default; logged for the team).
readiness.tax: Tax certificate valid if issued no more than {months} months before the deadline.
readiness.soon: Valid on the deadline but expiring within {days} days after it: stays documented, row carries a visible flag.

indication.title: Indication rules (exact wording from the service portfolio)
indication.nogo: at least one mandatory requirement is not met.
indication.borderline: no requirement is not met, but at least one is partly met, lacks data, has low match confidence, or demanded proof is not documented and valid on the tender deadline.
indication.go: all requirements met with high confidence, and all demanded proof documented and valid on the tender deadline.
indication.gap: Gap in the wording (logged for the team): a non-mandatory requirement that is not met, or a requirement met with medium confidence, fits neither borderline nor go. Agent default: borderline.

health.title: Profile health check (Service 3)
health.text: Flags expired entries, entries expiring within {days} days of the reference date, and values declared missing.

prompts.title: Prompts & I/O
prompts.sub: For each AI task: prompt text and version, the exact input, the raw output, the validated output and the schema and citation checks.
prompts.mockNote: Phase 1: the prompts are written and versioned but were NOT executed. Inputs are exactly what each prompt would receive; outputs are generated by code in the same schema.
prompts.inputSub: Contact fields and the Account/Baseline sections are never sent.
prompts.citationTable: Citation check and highlighting per requirement

adviser.sub: Release-gate queue with flag reasons, recorded decisions and their effect on screening and reports. Read-only: decisions are recorded by the team in data/adviser_decisions.json.

adviser.footnote: The flagged-notice failure mode (T7) is shown here on the mock run only. The notice data are never edited to provoke a flag.

lim.mock: Phase 1 mock run: requirements, sub-scores and classifications are generated by code from templates and describe no real tender.
lim.docs: Tender documents are placeholders until the team delivers the originals (Phase 2).

lim.flags: Flagged-notice and missing-deadline modes are shown with mock flags and MOCK notices; the real export is never edited.
lim.data: Firms are synthetic. Notice contact fields are kept unaltered as on doffin.no but never sent to an AI prompt.
